title: Gunluk hatirlatici
purpose: HomeReminderSettingScreen. Explains why notifications are needed before requesting permission (AC-FR-E2-08-01). Default reminder time 20:00, user-editable (AC-FR-E2-08-02). Skips repeat if comment already submitted today (AC-FR-E2-08-03). Phase 1: single daily reminder only (AC-FR-E2-08-04).

loading.description: Skeleton: explanation text block, time picker placeholder, CTA button skeleton.

ready.description: Explanation card: why notifications help learning consistency. Permission request button. Default time 20:00 shown in time picker row. User can tap to change time (time picker modal). Kaydet CTA. If comment already submitted today: 'Bugun tamamlandi' chip and reminder suppressed. AC-FR-E2-08-01/02/03/04 satisfied.

empty.description: Reminder not yet configured: Full setup flow shown. This is the primary path for first-time users.
